initial_random.method: uniform random sample of all conversations

cluster.method: k-means (8 clusters, course helper) on standardized turn_count, tool_call_count, distinct_tools, has_retrieval, words; nearest-to-centre members, spread across clusters; random picks excluded

dimension.method: dimension chosen before review: user role; 10 conversations per role, uniform random within each role

depth.method: depth searches: one deterministic retrieval signal per candidate mode, uniform random among hits; each pick is also a pending suggestion for the human to accept or reject

final_random.method: uniform random sample of the conversations not yet reviewed, drawn after the taxonomy draft

search_round2.method: second search after the incorrect_policy_claim definition was widened: orders from stores with their own policy where no policy was looked up, plus two store-name searches as malformed_tool_argument close negatives. Extends the depth searches and is kept separate from the four required batches.
